value: 2D sagittal-plane adaptation using 4 variables (hip, knee, ankle, trunk). Not equivalent to the standard 9-variable 3-plane GPS (Baker et al. 2009). Use for screening only.

myogait Sagittal Deviation Index (SDI): a 2D sagittal-plane deviation index using 4 variables (hip, knee, ankle, trunk). Normal gait scores ~100; pathological gait scores below 100. This is NOT the GDI of Schwartz & Rozumalski (2008). Use for screening only.
